history.title: Our story
history.imageAlt: Children and educators in a caring environment
history.p1: Les Petits Rayons de Soleil grew out of a love of early childhood and one simple wish: to give children a place where they could grow up in joy, safety and confidence.
history.p2: Our school grows a little more each day, just like the smiles of the children who took their first steps here. Today, {name} has become known for the quality of its care, combining modern teaching, kindness and real educational commitment — while keeping the family spirit it started with.
history.p3: Opening the preschool was the natural next step, so that we could stay alongside children throughout their development, right up to primary school.
history.p4: Every day, our team puts its whole heart into building a place where children learn, explore and flourish — because here, growing up is a bright adventure.

purpose.title: Our mission and our vision
purpose.missionBody: To give children a setting that feeds their curiosity and creativity, while building their ability to get along with others and explore the world. We walk beside each child on their own path, placing the emphasis on confidence, responsibility and personal discovery.
purpose.visionBody: To be a school where education reaches beyond academic learning, preparing children to become fulfilled, independent and open-minded people. An inspiring educational community, where parents and educators together build a richer future for every child.
